crossRefs.note: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.
These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash.…
“They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
“You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make…

translations.web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
translations.bsb: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
translations.kjv: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
translations.asv: onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
